title: Gradient Descent Optimization
subtitle: Watch a point roll downhill on a loss surface, following the negative gradient to find the minimum.
complexity: Each step computes gradient and updates parameters
complexityNote: Foundation of neural network training. Learning rate controls step size — too high causes oscillation, too low causes slow convergence.
steps: Start at a random point on the loss surface
Compute the gradient (direction of steepest ascent)
Move in the opposite direction (negative gradient)
Scale the step by the learning rate
Repeat until loss converges to a minimum
